# Table Borders

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Table Borders

First, let's add a border to the table to give it a more defined structure.

You can use the border property for this task. For example:

```html
1<table>
2    <caption>Table Caption</caption>
3    <tr>
4        <th>Name</th>
5        <th>Age</th>
6        <th>Country</th>
7    </tr>
8    <tr>
9        <td>Harry Depp</td>
10        <td>28</td>
11        <td>Britain</td>
12    </tr>
13    <tr>
14        <td>John Smith</td>
15        <td>35</td>
16        <td>USA</td>
17    </tr>
18    <tr>
19        <td>Ram Krishna</td>
20        <td>19</td>
21        <td>Nepal</td>
22    </tr>
23</table>
```

```css
1table {
2    border: 1px solid black;
3}
```

Browser Output

![HTML Table with Border](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, the table has a black border, making it more structured. But you'll notice the rows and columns inside the table still lack borders.
